evidence: Email tokens may not be sufficiently unique
HTML emails sent without Content-Type headers
recommendations: Use cryptographically secure random tokens (UUID4, secrets.token_urlsafe)
Always set Content-Type headers for HTML emails

test_results.description: Tests for social engineering vulnerabilities in password reset flows
evidence: User model has reset token field
recommendations: Ensure only one valid reset token exists at a time

evidence: Audit logging may not cover impersonation/role changes
No MFA enforcement for admin operations detected
recommendations: Require user confirmation for admin-initiated password changes
Add audit events for sensitive admin operations
Require MFA for all admin actions and impersonation

test_results.description: Tests for identity verification weaknesses in account recovery
Tests for SMS/phone verification bypass vulnerabilities
evidence: No TOTP authenticator app option (only SMS?)
recommendations: Consider implementing SMS verification as 2FA factor
If using SMS, be aware of SS7 vulnerabilities and SIM swapping risks
Implement TOTP (Google Authenticator) as more secure 2FA alternative
